name: ceramics-admin

dependencies.name: ceramics-api
dependencies.description: Manages the product catalog and inventory, and views/updates order fulfillment status.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Required store-owner sign-in via Thunder SSO; the admin area is unreachable without it.

description: The store owner's admin area: add/edit/remove products, set stock quantities, and view and update the fulfillment status of incoming orders. Reachable only when signed in as the store owner. Does not serve shopper-facing browsing, cart, or checkout — that is the storefront app's job.
